scope: The paired-recall procedure, candidate shared runtime and development compatibility comparison are specified below. This increment does not complete the internal/external pre-access freeze or change the matrix's hypothesis rules.

paired_recall.input: Saved binary predictions with exactly aligned unique record IDs and prepared registrable domains. Every supplied label must be integer 1. Select the declared positive outcome stratum only after any full-stream routing is complete.
paired_recall.domains: Use the prepared metadata produced with the pinned public-suffix rules. The statistics function checks canonical ASCII syntax, not provenance or public-suffix extraction.
paired_recall.sampling_unit: D distinct domains represented in the positive stratum; sample D domains uniformly with replacement per replicate, retaining all paired rows for every occurrence of a sampled domain
paired_recall.row_weighting: Sum candidate-minus-reference positive decisions over sampled rows and divide by their total row count. Unequal domain sizes therefore retain URL weighting; never average per-domain recalls.
paired_recall.rng_sequence: Construct a fresh local generator per contrast; make exactly one draw call per replicate, sequentially. Contrasts with the identical positive stratum and sorted domains therefore share draws. Do not use global RNG state, reroll, batch draws, or drop replicates.
paired_recall.degenerate_interval: For at least two domains, report a constant empirical bootstrap interval as calculated, with the row/domain counts; it does not establish population certainty.
paired_recall.missing_evidence: Reject invalid binary integers, missing or extra predictions, duplicate record IDs, mismatched IDs/order and invalid domain metadata. Never silently drop rows.
paired_recall.h2_orientation: FNR(fixed cascade) - FNR(policy) equals recall(policy) - recall(fixed cascade) on the same NCSC gold positive rows.
paired_recall.limitations: Inference is conditional on the observed positive stratum and frozen stream/order. Domain resampling does not capture cross-domain temporal dependence from shared routing activations or uncertainty over alternative stream orders. Few-domain and degenerate intervals require explicit qualification. This is not causal inference.
paired_recall.reporting: Retain candidate/reference true-positive counts, positive-row and domain counts, estimate, bounds, number of completed replicates and non-estimability reason. Apply the existing gate rules to unrounded endpoints only; missing bounds cannot support a gate.

runtime_candidate.rationale: Singleton scoring gives offline evaluation and selective serving the same per-request numerical path without microbatch formation or completion-order routing. This choice precedes bridge outcomes and is not chosen by favorable detection metrics.
runtime_candidate.baseline_scoring: Original raw URLs, frozen features/scalers/coefficients, float64 authoritative sklearn scoring with original column selection; one URL per call for length-only and Logistic-L1.
runtime_candidate.transformer_scoring: Existing character normalization, frozen eval-mode weights, inference_mode, deterministic algorithms with warn_only=false, disabled autocast, float32 sigmoid on MPS before CPU transfer; every forward contains exactly one URL. Warnings and nonfinite values stop the request.
runtime_candidate.session: One inference owner thread per process-wide numerical context. Set numerical-library limits once for the session and verify every reported pool and PyTorch intra-op count equals one. Restore settings on exit. A future service must preserve its declared request admission order through one owner queue.
runtime_candidate.monitor_feature: Keep the separately frozen portable Logistic-L1 probability as GMM feature 26; never substitute the authoritative classifier probability.
runtime_candidate.monitor_scoring: Score one 26-feature float64 row at a time; cache NLL in original stream order. Compute each complete 256-value window separately with the existing float64 numpy.mean and stride 64. No rolling cumulative-sum replacement.
runtime_candidate.invocation_accounting: Count actual transformer forward entries independently of routing selection, with attempted forwards separate from successfully validated scores. A failed attempt does not establish successful GPU work. Band and drift selection are unioned before a single forward.
runtime_candidate.cutoffs: Original thresholds, inclusive uncertainty band and strict GMM boundary are unchanged; no rounding tolerance changes a classification.

compatibility_bridge.allowed_inputs: Only the fixed hash-bound development-validation partition, preparation metadata, accepted artifacts, original private GMM validation trace, public summaries and frozen contracts. No training partition, internal group-test or external records.
compatibility_bridge.reference_fidelity: Restore accepted models without fitting. Baselines use original full-matrix sklearn scoring in Accelerate. Transformer uses the original _evaluate_validation no_grad/DataLoader path with batch 512, source order and final partial batch. GMM reference uses the original full feature-matrix scorer in OpenBLAS, retaining separate original calibration/audit domain allocation.
compatibility_bridge.candidate_fidelity: Use the shared singleton inference context for candidate length-only, Logistic-L1, transformer and cascade. Preserve the portable monitor feature and compare singleton GMM NLLs with the original full-matrix reference using the same frozen windows.
compatibility_bridge.exact_checks: First reproduce accepted reference validation confusion counts, the original cascade band-selection count, and saved GMM calibration/audit window scores and alerts. Require zero per-row binary-decision mismatches for all four detection models, zero inclusive-band-mask mismatches, and zero strict-window-alert mismatches separately in calibration and audit. Row identities and order must match exactly.
compatibility_bridge.numerical_differences: Report maximum absolute probability and NLL differences separately. They do not substitute for exact decision checks or authorize tolerance-based relabeling.
compatibility_bridge.failure_policy: Preserve a not-equivalent or execution-failure record with its stage. Do not retune, change the candidate, rank alternate runtimes by results, overwrite the receipt, or automatically retry. Any subsequent numerical-method amendment is explicit and prospective before protected evaluation.
compatibility_bridge.scope_of_success: A pass establishes the specified finite development comparison, not universal bitwise equivalence or generalization. The original GMM 28/252 failed audit and all historical summaries remain unchanged. The broader evaluation freeze still must be completed.
compatibility_bridge.publication: Preflight both runtime roles and bind a clean code revision and supplied contract SHA-256 before reading allowed input bytes. Keep row-level lane evidence private and temporary; publish one aggregate, no-overwrite receipt with provenance, counts, numerical differences and exact-match results.

remaining_freeze.manifest_sampling: Prevalence sampling, independent streams, stable ordering, repeats and warm-up order.
remaining_freeze.http_measurement: Service/client versions, workers, threads, queue, batch conventions, sockets, timing, timeout/error accounting and pooled quantiles.
remaining_freeze.numerical_runtime: The candidate convention and development bridge are specified above; execute the reviewed bridge and record its outcome before accepting the runtime for protected evaluation. Numerical closeness alone does not establish identical decisions or band/window membership.
remaining_freeze.secondary_analyses: Exact tests and families, calibration metrics, comparator/probe/perturbation definitions, and prospective reconciliation of seed and Random Forest commitments.
remaining_freeze.artifact_and_execution_bindings: Complete no-fit model interfaces, adapter, manifests, reviewed execution code, private artifacts, environment and final contract hashes. No protected-data runner is provided by this increment.
